_doc: Render massing for the K Tower (Diksmuidekaai 11, Philippe Samyn and Partners, completed 2018; 66 m, 20 floors; replaced the 60 m Collegetoren), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. GRB 6802479 (ground floor, 181 m2) and GBA 701163 (the upper floors, 294 m2) had 16 m from the DHMV II DSM, taken during the demolition, so the tower was missing (Tom's feedback 2026-11-14). Look (Street View, Google Maps photos, look-up only; visitkortrijk.be, infosteel.be): white residential tower of staggered glass and steel volumes with white balconies, on columns at the ground.
